source: Generated by scripts/deploy.py when this bundle was built: each task's controls.yaml, as its contract carries it, and the bundle's mode switches from deploy/manifests.json, as the controller itself reports them. The pad and the keyboard are two paths, each listed on its own.

modes.summary: The mode the robot starts in, and the one it returns to when no other is asked for.
modes.leave: Leaving it is switching to another mode.
modes.keyboard: A key held pushes what it drives further the longer it is held -- fully after 2 s -- and lets it back the moment it comes up, the height included: the keys place what the stick moves.

controls.does: up: walk forward; down: walk back
left: step left; right: step right
up: nose down; down: nose up; with right stick click (R3) held -- up: stand taller (moves it; let go, it stays); down: crouch lower (moves it; let go, it stays)
left: twist left, then turn left; right: twist right, then turn right; with right stick click (R3) held -- left: roll, left side down; right: roll, right side down
hold for the other stick layer; tapped -- pressed and let go without the stick moving -- puts the moved axes back at rest
let go of everything: every control back to rest

keys.does: let go of everything: every control back to rest
